title: Decommission
description: The device's active life ends - explanted, recalled, destroyed, disposed, or retired at end of service life. Never patient-linked (spec Sec.9): reason "explanted" records that a specific serialized device came out of service, never who it came out of. A subject that already carries a decommission reappearing afterward - under installation or handover-equivalent events - is a structural contradiction a client or monitor can flag, the same pattern gray-market equipment reuse and pharma.v1's vaccine-fraud case both share.
